title: Take-out Orders
html:
Quest Giver: town.npc.TownCommander

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Take out Capwn and his Crew down in Capwn's Family Ratstaurant off of Algernon Level 3. If any Oroks try and start a fight (they will), go ahead and take them out as well. When finished, return to the Townston Commander in Townston. Don't forget to look for the take-out order.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: town.npc.TownCommander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Take out Capwn and his Crew down in Capwn's Family Ratstaurant off of Algernon Level 3. If any Oroks try and start a fight (they will), go ahead and take them out as well. When finished, return to the Townston Commander in Townston. Don't forget to look for the take-out order.

Offer:

From Agent Prohi's report, it sounds like the Whiskers setting up in Capwn's Family Ratstaurant is a bad thing. Well I simply can't argue with logic like that. It looks like I'll have to just order in.

I need you to head down into Capwn's Family Ratstaurant, off of Algernon Level 3, and take out Ratphonse Capwn and his Crew. It's a popular Ratstaurant, so there are bound to be some Whiskers there. Also be careful, there are probably some protesting Oroks trying to start an argument. It's probably safer to take them out as well.

When you finish, make sure you wash your hands and then inform me, the Townston Commander, of your progress. Also, if you happen to see an order for take-out down there with my name on it, could you bring it back up? Thanks a bunch.

Turn-in:

I just got a report that you didn't get Capwn at all. It was his stunt-double! It looks like the real Capwn has gone into hiding. Well, at least you did some damage. You can always try again, maybe you'll get the real Capwn the next time and not his stunt double.

Oh! Is that my take-out order? Here's the money for your delivery and a nice tip.

Objectives:

  • Take-out Orok Spawn
  • Take-out Orok Warrior
  • Take-out Orok Scout
  • Take-out FizzStar-soaked Blademaster
  • Take-out Capwn
  • Take-out Order ×1

Client level range: 5–20
